structured_requirements.final_statement: The electronic door locking system shall generate monthly reports containing all granted and denied admittances to the building.
structuring_notes: AMB-01 resolved: fragment 'granted and denied admittances' clarified to list every individual event including both granted and denied per supported interpretation.
AMB-02 resolved: fragment 'all granted and denied admittances' clarified to contain records of every access attempt distinguishing between allowed and rejected per supported interpretation.
Core predicate is 'generate' (system action) → functional_requirement. Original phrasing preserved as both interpretations align with the original intent.
